translations.web: He who troubles his own house shall inherit the wind. The foolish shall be servant to the wise of heart.
translations.bsb: He who brings trouble on his house will inherit the wind, and the fool will be servant to the wise of heart.
translations.kjv: He that troubleth his own house shall inherit the wind: and the fool shall be servant to the wise of heart.
